summary: First-iteration full-stack testing of A1 Field Pro MVP. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (auth incl. cookies, jobs CRUD, dashboard stats, team, customers, multi-tenant isolation, RBAC, Stripe checkout). Frontend: landing, login, owner→dashboard redirect, technician→my-jobs redirect, sidebar role-based nav, seeded job listing, and My Jobs sections all render correctly via Playwright.

issues: No data-testid on key interactive elements (login email/password/submit, New Work Order button, job modal fields, sidebar items, charge buttons). Testing relied on text/type selectors. Adding data-testid would improve automated-test stability.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes across forms, sidebar nav items, action buttons (New Work Order, Charge, Edit, Save, login fields) to harden E2E testability.
Optional: include /api prefix for register response so it surfaces token under a consistent key (currently both cookie and token returned — fine).
Consider rate-limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (not currently enforced — playbook recommends 5-fail lockout). Not in MVP scope but flag for security hardening.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 600+ lines; consider splitting into routers/{auth,jobs,team,customers,payments,dashboard}.py modules once it crosses 700 lines.
bcrypt verified ($2b$ format), httpOnly+secure+samesite=None cookie set correctly, CORS uses explicit origins with allow_credentials=true — auth playbook compliant.
seed_demo is idempotent: updates password if env-mismatch, returns early if owner exists — good.
No brute-force lockout / login throttling; consider for production.
/api/payments/checkout correctly excludes _id, uses metadata, creates payment_transactions record with status=initiated — compliant with Stripe playbook.
test_credentials: demo@a1fieldpro.com / Demo1234! (owner), dispatcher@a1fieldpro.com / Demo1234!, tech@a1fieldpro.com / Demo1234! — all working as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 1 company (A1 HVAC N DE-GO), 3 users, 4 jobs on startup — verified via test_list_jobs_seeded and UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_a1fieldpro.py — re-runnable regression. Frontend create-job modal flow was not fully exercised because the button label is 'New Work Order' (not 'New Job'); next iteration should explicitly target text='New Work Order' or add data-testid='create-job-btn'. My Jobs section labels are uppercase ('TODAY','UPCOMING','COMPLETED') — use case-insensitive matching.
rca of the issue: No app bugs. Two minor test-script gaps: (1) create-job modal selector did not include 'New Work Order' text; (2) section labels match was case-sensitive — both are script issues, not product bugs. UI screenshots confirm the missing functionality is in fact present and working.
